name: Hayasaka Shizuru
source:
A good young man who isn't two-faced, Shizuru is Hotori's classmate. Sociable, he possesses the ability to treat anybody without any discrimination. He's not only very popular in his class, but also the entire grade. Hotori admires him.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/un_birth/chara_shizuru.html]official website profile[/URL].]
